{{Quote|Pleasure to serve you, sir. Will you be dining alone, or will someone be joining you?''"<br />"''Senator Roki Kem will be arriving soon.|A Twi'lek server and Ivaar Workan|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''The Nook''' was a small, fashionable [[Restaurant/Legends|breakfast diner]] within walking distance of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had multiple booths and opened from four in the [[Local day/Legends|morning]] till noon, and employed a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] server. [[Ivaar Workan]], a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] posing as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Kameron Suldar, met [[Abeloth]], posing as Senator [[Rokari Kem]], in The Nook, where Workan enjoyed a cup of [[Caf/Legends|black caf]] with powdered [[taka root]] and an [[peko peko egg omelet]]. He recommended the establishment's "very good" [[Omelette/Legends|omelet]] and fresh [[brul]] juice.<ref name="Ascension" />
